verdict.rationale: Hugging Face's official huggingface_hub client can download an entire repo snapshot (`snapshot_download`), and its CLI example shows hosting models in the open safetensors format, so hosted repo content can be pulled off the platform with first-party tooling. Nothing documents an account-wide export of all user data, or what formats such an export would use. missing for 10: documented full-account data export (all repos, datasets, Spaces, discussions, settings), explicit open-format guarantees for exported data, offboarding/deletion guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
